intro: This directive dispatches seasoned Horde champions from major capitals to reinforce an outpost in the western Barrens. The veteran warrior Regthar Deathgate is marshaling capable volunteers for an impending campaign across the mountains into the arid wastes of Desolace. He seeks those willing to carry Horde steel against the entrenched centaur clans terrorizing the frontier.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A warrior of the Horde, Regthar Deathgate, is recruiting agents for a mission into the land of Desolace. Speak with him if you wish to volunteer. He is stationed in the Barrens, in a series of bunkers west of the Crossroads.
And sharpen your weapons. Desolace is a place torn by war.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, I am recruiting. This mission leads into Desolace, against the centaur there. I will be brief so that you may quickly begin.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
